gloss: at a stroke, all at once

definitions.gloss: at a stroke, all at once, in one go
definitions.explanation: Doing something all at once or in a single action, rather than gradually or in stages.

examples.japanese: {一挙|いっきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To resolve everything at a stroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一挙|いっきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I dealt with the problems all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、{一挙|いっきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三点|さんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}った→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: That goal changed the momentum, and they scored three points in one burst.

notes:
{一挙|いっきょ} means doing something all at once or in a single decisive action. It is most commonly used as an adverb ({一挙|いっきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

FORMS:
{一|いっ} (one) + {挙|きょ} (raise, action) = one action

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一挙|いっきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: all at once, in one go
- {一挙|いっきょ}{両得|りょうとく}: killing two birds with one stone
- {一挙|いっきょ}{一動|いちどう}: every move, every action
- {一挙|いっきょ}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: marathon broadcast (airing all episodes at once)

USAGE:
{一挙|いっきょ}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧ and {一挙|いっきょ}⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧ are commonly seen in TV and streaming contexts, meaning a binge-style broadcast or release of multiple episodes at once.
